svg.aria-label: A waiver before and after. Before: the whole film waived for text-low-contrast with a reason that says a threshold is an open decision. After: text-low-contrast@2.25 with a reason naming world hot, 2.25 s and 4.4:1 against 4.5:1.

g.text: Reason: an approved display type, and the threshold is an open decision.
Hides every later contrast finding in the whole film. Names no place, no number.
After: scoped to a second, with a measure
Reason: world hot, 2.25 s: "nsen" crosses the dye flood at 4.4:1
against the 4.5:1 limit and lands readable by 2.5 s.
From the public example film colour-sting, commit 805a5427c.
